Goldman Sachs expects headline inflation to peak at 3.4% year over year in the fourth quarter of 2026. Core inflation will peak at 2.7% year over year in the first quarter of 2027, before gradually declining to 2.0% in the fourth quarter of 2028, the economists forecast. “The risks, however, remain somewhat to the upside bearing in mind renewed geopolitical tensions, rising refined products prices and recent moves higher in gas prices.”
